name: Selvara
overview: One of Dubai's most well-known and reliable developers, Emaar Properties, is pleased to introduce Selvara, a stunning new residential development that is set to revolutionize luxury living in the center of Dubai. Located inside the esteemed Grand Polo Club & Resort, Selvara provides an unmatched fusion of luxury, eco-friendliness, and contemporary style, establishing a sanctuary for individuals who demand the finest in life.
